answer: Charge a compounding tax on any standing transferred between identities: 10% of the amount plus an extra 5% for each additional funding source involved. Consolidating a 200-alias farm into one identity thus pays a tax that grows with every plume of funding trace, and the public delta ledger lets auditors follow each flow back to its origin. A legitimately earned reputation never moves, so honest agents sit in the tax-free haven while any attempted merge becomes a losing trade.
